data.name: Hoorin
data.gender_notes: Hoorin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hoorin means 'a radiant light'. It is derived from the root 'hawr' meaning 'light'. This name is significant in Islamic tradition, as it is mentioned in the Quran as a name for Paradise. The name Hoorin carries the meaning “Radiant light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hoorin usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for Paradise in Islamic tradition
data.etymology: Hoorin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hoorin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Hoorin
in_english.long_meaning: Hoorin is an Arabic name that refers to beautiful and lovely women. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-w-r' which means 'to be white' or 'to be beautiful'. In Islamic tradition, Hoorin is used to describe the women of Paradise. The name has a rich history and is significant in Islamic culture, symbolizing beauty, elegance, and refinement.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hoorin holds significant cultural importance in Islamic civilization. It is associated with paradise, or 'Jannah', in Islamic belief. The Hoorin are described as beautiful, radiant-faced maidens who will reside in paradise and serve as companions for the men who attain it (Quran 52:20 and 56:22). This concept of paradise with beautiful companions for the righteous is a common theme in Islamic art, literature, and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hoorin carries deep spiritual significance for Muslims. It represents the eternal bliss and happiness that awaits believers in paradise. It serves as a motivation and reward for the righteous during their earthly journey. The name Hoorin is also a reminder of the transient nature of this world and the eternal nature of the hereafter. It inspires Muslims to strive towards righteousness and instills a sense of hope and anticipation for the paradise that lies beyond this life.
